description: M2.5 golden-set — 시드 위키 컨텐츠(픽스처 ingest 8건)에 대한 질의 10개와 기대 citation path. 시드는 changes/<session_id>.md 페이지로 적재된다(키워드 폴백 ingest 경로).

seed.summary: Authentication issues signed session cookies with sliding expiry

spec_changes.description: Login issues a signed session cookie with a sliding expiry of fourteen days
spec_changes.reasoning: bcrypt password hashing protects stored credentials and cookies must not outlive inactivity

seed.summary: Payment gateway enforces idempotency keys on every charge request

spec_changes.description: Charges carry idempotency keys so webhook retries never duplicate a settlement
spec_changes.reasoning: duplicate settlements would corrupt the ledger during gateway webhook replays

seed.summary: Search relies on an inverted index with Porter stemming

spec_changes.description: Documents are tokenized into an inverted index with Porter stemming before relevance ranking
spec_changes.reasoning: relevance ranking needs normalized tokens to stay stable across word forms

seed.summary: Notifications batch into digest emails respecting quiet hours

spec_changes.description: Digest emails aggregate notifications and respect per-user quiet hours windows
spec_changes.reasoning: midnight pushes hurt retention so delivery waits for the quiet hours window to end

seed.summary: Object storage uploads use presigned URLs with multipart chunks

spec_changes.description: Clients upload via presigned URLs split into multipart chunks of eight megabytes
spec_changes.reasoning: direct browser uploads keep the API stateless and avoid proxying large payloads

seed.summary: Localization uses ICU message format with locale negotiation

spec_changes.description: Strings ship as ICU message format bundles and locale negotiation falls back to English
spec_changes.reasoning: pluralization rules differ per locale and raw template strings cannot express them

seed.summary: Telemetry emits structured logs with trace sampling

spec_changes.description: Services emit structured logs and apply trace sampling at one percent of requests
spec_changes.reasoning: alert thresholds depend on consistent telemetry volume across services

seed.summary: Rate limiting applies a token bucket with burst allowance

spec_changes.description: The API throttles with a token bucket of sixty requests and a burst allowance of ten
spec_changes.reasoning: throttling headers must expose the remaining quota to well-behaved clients

queries.question: How long is the sliding expiry of the signed session cookie?
Why do charges carry idempotency keys in the payment gateway?
Which stemming algorithm does the inverted index use for relevance ranking?
When do digest emails respect quiet hours for notifications?
How large are the multipart chunks used with presigned URLs?
How does locale negotiation fall back when ICU message format bundles are missing?
What sampling rate applies to distributed traces in telemetry?
What burst allowance does the token bucket rate limiting allow?
What does specraft keep as the one source of project truth?
Where are webhook retries documented for duplicate settlement protection?
